items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] T-Boy Remy. [INTERVIEWEE] That's a long set, because I was no more than about, oh, 13 or 14 years old. Yeah, well that's after them. That was the Golden Leaf Band. My cousin used to play bass with them.

ctx.x: Who was playing, what was, Davis playing bass, fella called Davis playing bass? No, I was Lennon-Wop playing. Lennon-Wop. Well, that's after them. Yeah, that's right. Lennon-Wop took the band after them. Yeah. I was no more than about... You know who was playing trumpet?

That's a long set, because I was no more than about, oh, 13 or 14 years old. Yeah, well that's after them. That was the Golden Leaf Band. My cousin used to play bass with them. Yeah. My cousin died, Gus Greenbott, his bass. I used to call him Dougie.
